name: Acme Tools

research_snapshot.reported_mechanism: Price Drop /price-drop/?start=24&sz=24 (and /new/price-drop/). Indexed first and offset pages show SKU#, in-stock/available-to-order, shipping class, current, Was and Save percent.
research_snapshot.reported_extraction: Each listing includes real MPN/SKU in text; e.g. bare tool vs combo kit and refurbished/reconditioned are explicitly labeled.
research_snapshot.known_risks: Freight shipping vs ground, reconditioned item condition, free battery with purchase and “available to order” not necessarily stock.
